title: Hello (agent to router, text frame)
description: The agent's signed login, answering the challenge within 15 s. At most 32 KiB (UTF-8). The router verifies the Ed25519 signature over nonce || UTF-8(node) || pubkey (raw bytes, in this order); the identity of the agent is the SHA-256 of pubkey. A hello that is not JSON, not this type, has non-base64 pubkey or sig, a key that is not 32 bytes, facts that are not an object, or a wrong signature closes the connection with code 4001.

node.description: Node name the agent asks for. Covered by the signature. The router cuts it to 64 characters before verifying, so a longer name never verifies. Empty or absent: the router uses facts.hostname, else the key fingerprint. A new identity gets a sanitised, unique name (lower case, at most 40 characters).

pubkey.description: Raw 32-byte Ed25519 public key, standard base64 with padding.

sig.description: Ed25519 signature (64 bytes) over nonce || UTF-8(node) || pubkey, standard base64 with padding.

facts.description: What the agent knows about its machine (facts.schema.json). Absent counts as empty.

agent.description: Agent version, informational; the router reads facts.agent_version instead.
